title: A-A crowd at rest, up to 16 particles, T <= 0.3: the P-0024 pair law, summed pairwise, predicts positions to 0.007

claims.statement: Up to 16 A particles, all at rest, with every initial pairwise distance in [1.5, 10.5] and duration at most 0.3: each particle accelerates toward each other particle with magnitude (G/2) / q^P, where q is the separation to that particle, G = 23.63 and P = 2.099 (chamber and time units), and the accelerations add. Measured positions are predicted to a judged RMSE of 0.007 of the chamber side. The claim is for species A only, at rest, with no statement about other species, particles with initial velocity, durations above 0.3, or any other exponent or coefficient. It rests on one 16-particle run; no N-body correction is needed at this duration within the stated noise.
